summary: Tenant-gate all learning commands and their profile-scoped artifacts, and share CLI campaign compliance checks with MCP execution.
reason: Local learning data contains tenant resource IDs and must never use an unverified database or fall back to another profile's logs. MCP confirmation does not replace unsubscribe preflight. Receipts stay opt-in as published; the older records' "mandatory receipts" wording means a receipt is written whenever one is requested.
validated_outcome: Focused tests cover every learning command's tenant gate, two bound profiles' database/journal/log isolation, refusal of mismatched database tenant metadata, legacy log exclusion, zero POSTs for non-compliant MCP sends and assignments, and successful compliant writes. Existing learning assertions are retained with verified session and database fixtures.
